title: Life in a Day
notes: Artful, tense guitar pop with theatrical vocal edges; early experiments foreshadow stronger rhythmic abstraction.

title: Real to Real Cacophony
notes: Angular, exploratory post-punk; hypnotic bass, synthesizers and corridor ambience shape unsettled urban miniatures.

title: Empires and Dance
notes: Severe European travelogue: motorik bass grooves, synthetic pulses, brittle guitars and politically tense imagery.

title: Sons and Fascination
notes: Hillage steers dense, spacious post-punk toward insistent bass-led dance patterns and wider emotional reach.

title: Sister Feelings Call
notes: Instrumental urban dance patterns, assertive bass and tense post-punk beside theatrical, socially observant songs.

title: New Gold Dream (81-82-83-84)
influenced_by: The Human League|ABC|Talking Heads|Roxy Music|Grace Jones|Can
notes: Shimmering synthetic atmospheres, supple bass and lighter guitars bring hopeful, exploratory pop into focus.

title: Sparkle in the Rain
sounds_like: U2|Big Country|Roxy Music|Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark
notes: Lillywhite amplifies muscular live-band dynamics: pounding drums, emphatic bass and luminous keyboard textures.

title: Once Upon a Time
notes: Huge guitar-driven choruses and choir-like backing vocals refine the group’s expansive mid-eighties rock sound.
